column1: # jespersen's own American English entries, dedicated to the public domain (CC0)
# with the rest of the repository. Each replaces CMUdict's entries for its word.
# One line per pronunciation, most common first: word<TAB>ARPAbet phonemes with
# CMUdict's stress digits. Add a word only with a reason in a comment above it.
# The plural's s is voiced, as in house (verb); CMUdict has only s.
# CMUdict has d and secondary stress on the last syllable.
# Verse's elisions of a consonant, one syllable as dictionaries give them (even, ever, over, taken):
# CMUdict lacks them, and rules would read each letter.
# The same elision of ever at the end of a word, stressed there (whatever, however).
